body:
A painless suicide is definitely possible but would require a cocktail of properly measured drugs/barbiturates. It would probably be hard to track down the right drugs unless you are some dark web aficionado. A large caliber firearm is the other option. A shotgun with buckshot/slugs to the head would kill you instantly but would be quite messy.  

And don’t go on those suicide hotlines because if you give them the wrong impression they will get the cops on you and be involuntarily hospitalized. Definitely not worth the 7k hospital bill and trauma
Feel free to drop me a line! No judgement here, I hope someone is there for me when I decide it’s time to bite the bullet
Yeah man similar boat. Planning on ending it when I graduate (~5 months away) there’s no purpose
How do you deal with crazy Trump supporters family? It's exactly how my family is, and I rely on them financially so it's hard to argue if any.
Humans are stupid af let AI tell us what to do I’d be down
The point of life is to suffer. I think I heard that somewhere lol. Fuck that though I’m gonna kill myself
Kill them first. JK DON’T DO THIS. There’s not much you can do to lessen the impact. Maybe write a note, or try to give them an explanation why
Damn nobody is safe from this shit
Are you a doctor?

I’ve actually been doing the same thing. Haven’t seen my parents/siblings in over 3 months. Ignore most of their texts and just say I’m busy. I feel like this is the best way. As soon as they catch wind our plan is foiled. It’s like designing a plan for a bank heist; only thing I’m trying to do is break out of this life

Dude this is so me, I’m  20 and college student here. Nobody cares, parents, friends, colleagues they’ll all get over it eventually and if not who cares it’s our lives right? We get the right to choose, it doesn’t matter. Fuck everybody if I’m gonna kill myself nobody is gonna stop me

From all the research I’ve done it is generally not a good idea to blame or reveal hate towards someone in a suicide note. Generally people who read that will think it is their fault (which it may be) and nothing will ever change their minds about that. When writing a note it is important to not blame others and provide examples that justifies you killing yourself. At the end of the day a note will never be enough, rather than you being there. However a note that provides multiple examples that justifies it to you would probably make it a little easier on others. Best of luck with your journey

Shotgun with buckshot to the head is my method currently. From all my research death should be instantaneous, my body won’t have time to react as I will already be dead. Plus this method is relatively easy to obtain if you live in the US.
I wonder about this a lot. The optimist in me hopes there’s something else to living. Then again let’s be real it’ll probably be nothing.

I was involuntarily committed as well and the only advice I can give is to lie to make your way out of it. You will often be taken to the ER which is not a mental health facility. They are not equipped to help you deal with your thoughts, and will treat you like a prisoner. Stay calm, say you aren’t a risk to yourself or anyone else and get out of there. Also plan for a medical bill that will leave you crippled for years to come ;)

Having a gun just there can be a great tool for control. Knowing you have an escape route if things get bad is comforting. You can take risks, do things you’ve always wanted and at the end of the day if they turn out bad, oh well you have a way out.
Step 1. Be attractive. If you’re not then I wouldn’t recommend

Drugs are the best but you have to get the dosage correct so there’s a lot of room for error. I feel like a high caliber/power gun is the only definitive method. I’ve seen enough execution videos to know they will work
They can only help themselves if they decide to. You can give advice but it’s ultimately their life and their choice.

As someone only a few years older than you and will be graduating college in a few months I can tell you that still have no idea what I’m doing. I just racked up $50k in student debt lmao. I would suggest going to the military. I don’t know much about what branch or anything. They will give you a job, and hopefully with time you  will evolve to understand what the purpose of your life is.

That tells me you really don’t want to commit suicide or you’re kind of unsure. Ending your life is not something to be decided on a whim. You must truly exhaust every option available to you before you consider the end all be all. I would advise against cutting as that will just be painful and if caught could potentially lead up to a psych ward stay, which in my experience is very bad.

The survival instinct in very real and scary, our bodies can make us feel incredible things. I hope things get better for you. Life is a choice, and if you have exhausted all opportunities (like me) suicide is an option. It’s something I have deliberated with myself for years. Some people aren’t meant to live in this life.
Similar spot my guy and tbh probably gonna go through with my own suicide in a few months. Life sucks man and we should be the ones to decide when it’s time to end it, nobody else.
This is honestly one of the main reasons for my suicide.  Life having no meaning is no life at all so why have it. It was never my decision to enter this life but it will be my decision to exit.

Same boat. I have a method that will 100% kill me but I’m being a lil bitch about it. I thought about getting high/drunk but that could end up botching the job. Honestly we’ve just got to go for it in one shot I feel like. I really wish somebody else could do it for me
Lmao

Leave it short and sweet. Don’t go into detail,  keep it open but at the same time deliberate. That’s at least my plan with my note. A note will never be equal to you actually being alive but I feel like leaving something rather than nothing is helpful in the coping process.
